create_InferenceBasedLoader: create an InferenceBasedLoader with a model, data loader, batch size, and optional data sampler
use_ScoreBasedFilter: use a ScoreBasedFilter to discard model output instances with scores below a minimum threshold
iterate_InferenceBasedLoader: iterate over an InferenceBasedLoader to yield batches of sampled annotation data from model inference
use_grouper: use the grouper utility to chunk an iterable into fixed-size tuples with optional fill values
configure_InferenceBasedLoader_shuffle: configure an InferenceBasedLoader with shuffle enabled and a category to class mapping dictionary
